question: In Slack: Unarchive the incidents channel about the checkout outage. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
There isn't one to unarchive. I checked all channels in the workspace (including archived):

- `engineering-general` (active)
- `incidents-auth` (active)
- `incidents-billing` (archived)
- `incidents-shipping` (archived)

No `incidents-checkout` or similar channel exists — a message in `#incidents-shipping` references it ("picked up checkout outage triage overflow since #incidents-checkout filled up"), so it existed at some point but appears to have been deleted rather than archived, which is why there's nothing to unarchive.

If you want, I can unarchive one of the existing incident channels (e.g. `incidents-shipping`, where the checkout triage overflow lives), or create a fresh `incidents-checkout` channel.
